description: Defines a template class DqMmaMultistage for double-buffered threadblock-scoped GEMM kernels with dequantization, including shared memory management, warp-level MMA, and cp.async pipeline stages.

classes.name: DqMmaMultistage
classes.description: A template class implementing a double-buffered, threadblock-scoped GEMM kernel with dequantization, shared memory staging, and warp-level MMA, supporting multiple stages and cp.async pipeline.

methods.name: DqMmaMultistage
methods.description: Constructor initializing shared memory, warp dequantizer, and shared memory iterators based on thread and warp indices.

methods.name: copy_tiles_and_advance
methods.description: Copies tiles from global memory to shared memory asynchronously and advances iterators.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Performs the GEMM operation with pipelined stages, including shared memory management, warp-level MMA, and optional clearing of last stage shared memory.
